g.text: Random scores, seq 12. Masking before the softmax lets it normalize over exactly the allowed keys, so every row sums to 1.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Zeroing probabilities afterwards leaves early rows summing to far less than 1, shrinking the output by an amount that

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: depends on position — a bug that trains, but badly.
